title: pinvoke.net auxiliary constant row
description: One constant the pinvoke.net P/Invoke reference wiki prints (knowledge/aux/, the isolated weak-auxiliary layer -- NOT part of the kb/ specification): a C# const spelling or a #define spelling on one of its pages.  name and value are as printed on the wiki; module is the wiki section the page is filed under and header is DERIVED from it (weak).  A pinvoke value is never treated as a Windows CE value: the generator consumes these rows only as the weakest constant/header linkage hint and only where Microsoft's own documentation states nothing.
